classification.difficultyReason: Draw sums and differences of two given vectors using a square grid.

spec.description: Eight-by-eight square grid with separately positioned labelled vectors. The blank-grid template cannot express the given vectors.
spec.mathematics: a moves 2 squares right and 1 up; b moves 1 square right and 1 down.

sizing.reason: Match actual native12x9 response grids at4mm square units; retain full48x36mm drawing extent and allcells. Given8x8 grid has32mm actual drawing extent plus4mm label margins each side,40mm total. Native10pt labels preserved.

spec.description: Left third of the source response grid.

answer.worked: Place $\underset{\sim}{b}$ tip to tail after $\underset{\sim}{a}$. The upward and downward movements cancel. Draw the resultant from the first tail to the final tip: 3 squares right.

spec.description: Complete response grid with the resultant arrow.
Middle third of the source response grid.

answer.worked: Add $-\underset{\sim}{b}$, which moves 1 square left and 1 up, tip to tail after $\underset{\sim}{a}$. Draw the resultant 1 square right and 2 squares up.

spec.description: Complete response grid with the resultant arrow.
Right third of the source response grid.

answer.worked: Add $-\underset{\sim}{a}$, which moves 2 squares left and 1 down, tip to tail after $\underset{\sim}{b}$. Draw the resultant 1 square left and 2 squares down.

spec.description: Complete response grid with the resultant arrow.
